text:
Rina: opened PR to tighten up the quickstart auth examples — standardize env var to REDWOOD_API_KEY and add a short Powershell note. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4201
Omar: nice. can we also replace raw curl output with `| jq -r .text` to make it friendlier?
Rina: done. swapped curl output and added a one-liner troubleshooting tip for 401s.
Priya: tiny nit: the CLI snippet still had `--region=us-west-2`. please remove or mark optional.
Rina: removed region and added a callout "optional: use --region for Dedicated/private". pushed.
DocsBot: PR queued (snippet-lint, markdown-check, smoke-e2e).
Omar: snippet-lint passed. smoke-e2e failed once due to staging flake, retried and passed.
Priya: approved, merging once DocsBot auto-merge fires.
Rina: thanks y'all — will follow up with a short matrix for Windows/mac/linux env var set commands.
DocsBot: PR #4201 merged and published to staging (build docs-2026-03-24-03).
